obligations.text: No provider version is qualified while a scenario's capture for it differs from that scenario's golden in a way neither the golden nor a reviewed divergence-ledger entry accounts for.
Every golden names its provider version, platform, scenario and capture date, and the comparison refuses a capture whose version or scenario does not match the golden it is compared to.
A quarantined capture is excluded from comparison only with a recorded reason and is kept, never deleted; lifting it requires a fresh capture.
Comparison runs offline: it spawns no provider, opens no network connection and reads no credential.

A synthetic capture differing from its golden in a mapped field refuses qualification; the same capture with a reviewed ledger entry passes; a quarantined golden is skipped and reported; the comparison runs in CI with networking denied.

record.summary: Turns the Claude Code adapter's recorded streams into a governed corpus of golden captures, each pinned to a provider version and a named scenario, with a quarantine list for captures that are wrong recordings and a divergence ledger for differences a reviewer has accepted. A new provider version is compared against the goldens offline; an unreviewed divergence refuses that version's qualification. Capturing costs provider usage, so it is owner-triggered; comparison runs in CI with no provider and no network.
record.title: Version-pinned provider captures, a quarantine and a divergence ledger gate a new provider version
